name: New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan) (GNDTDC)
benefit:
**1. Loan Amount:** The maximum loan limit for this scheme is up to ₹10,00,000/-.
**2. Included Expenses:** The loan amount will include the following:

- Admission and tuition fees
- Expenses for books, uniforms, essential materials, and exam fees
- Accommodation and food expenses
- Insurance – Policy premium

**3. Interest Rate:** 

- 4% per annum for male students
- 3.5% per annum for female st
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should be pursuing one of the following courses: - MBA or its equivalent (AICTE-approved course) - MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or its equivalent (AICTE-approved course) - Graduate-level engineering course approved by IIT/AICTE or any other approved professional graduate-level course - Graduate-level medical course from a college recognized by the Medical Council of India - Diploma course in Nursing **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-.
